data.name: Connection_Established
data.value: Connection established successfully to PLC at {0}
data.comment: Message displayed when PLC connection is successful. {0} is the PLC address.

data.name: Connection_Failed
data.value: Failed to connect to PLC at {0}: {1}
data.comment: Message displayed when PLC connection fails. {0} is the PLC address, {1} is the error message.

data.name: Connection_Timeout
data.value: Connection to PLC at {0} timed out after {1} seconds
data.comment: Message displayed when PLC connection times out. {0} is the PLC address, {1} is the timeout duration.

data.name: Connection_Closed
data.value: Connection to PLC at {0} has been closed
data.comment: Message displayed when PLC connection is closed. {0} is the PLC address.

data.name: Memory_Dump_Started
data.value: Memory dump started for range {0:X8} - {1:X8} ({2} bytes)
data.comment: Message displayed when memory dump begins. {0} is start address, {1} is end address, {2} is total bytes.

data.name: Memory_Dump_Progress
data.comment: Message displayed during memory dump progress. {0} is percentage, {1} is current bytes, {2} is total bytes.

data.name: Memory_Dump_Completed
data.value: Memory dump completed successfully. {0} bytes written to {1}
data.comment: Message displayed when memory dump completes. {0} is total bytes, {1} is output file path.

data.name: Memory_Read_Started
data.value: Reading memory from address {0:X8}, length {1} bytes
data.comment: Message displayed when memory read operation starts. {0} is address, {1} is length.

data.name: Memory_Write_Started
data.comment: Message displayed when memory write operation starts. {0} is length, {1} is address.

data.name: Handshake_Started
data.comment: Message displayed when handshake process begins. {0} is the PLC address.

data.name: Handshake_Success
data.value: Handshake completed successfully with PLC at {0}
data.comment: Message displayed when handshake completes successfully. {0} is the PLC address.

data.name: Handshake_Failed
data.comment: Message displayed when handshake fails. {0} is the PLC address, {1} is the error message.

data.name: Handshake_Retry
data.comment: Message displayed when retrying handshake. {0} is PLC address, {1} is current attempt, {2} is max attempts.

data.name: Stager_Installation_Started
data.comment: Message displayed when stager installation begins. {0} is the stager file path.

data.name: Stager_Installation_Progress
data.comment: Message displayed during stager installation. {0} is percentage, {1} is current bytes, {2} is total bytes.

data.name: Stager_Installation_Completed
data.comment: Message displayed when stager installation completes successfully.

data.name: Stager_Verification_Started
data.comment: Message displayed when stager verification begins.

data.name: Stager_Verification_Success
data.comment: Message displayed when stager verification succeeds.

data.name: Payload_Loading_Started
data.comment: Message displayed when payload loading begins. {0} is the payload file path.

data.name: Payload_Loading_Completed
data.comment: Message displayed when payload loading completes. {0} is the payload size in bytes.

data.name: Payload_Execution_Started
data.comment: Message displayed when payload execution begins. {0} is the execution address.

data.name: Payload_Execution_Completed
data.comment: Message displayed when payload execution completes.

data.name: Protocol_Packet_Sent

data.name: Protocol_Packet_Received
data.comment: Message displayed when a protocol packet is received. {0} is packet size, {1} is packet type.

data.name: Protocol_Error_Detected
data.comment: Message displayed when a protocol error is detected. {0} is the error description.

data.name: Protocol_Checksum_Verified
data.comment: Message displayed when packet checksum verification succeeds.

data.name: File_Loading_Started

data.name: File_Loading_Completed
data.comment: Message displayed when file loading completes. {0} is file path, {1} is file size.

data.name: File_Saving_Started
data.comment: Message displayed when file saving begins. {0} is the file path.

data.name: File_Saving_Completed
data.comment: Message displayed when file saving completes. {0} is file path, {1} is file size.

data.name: Configuration_Loading_Started

data.name: Configuration_Loading_Completed
data.comment: Message displayed when configuration loading completes successfully.

data.name: Configuration_Saving_Started
data.comment: Message displayed when configuration saving begins. {0} is the configuration file path.

data.name: Configuration_Saving_Completed
data.comment: Message displayed when configuration saving completes successfully.
